method: One-pass qualitative review of all 100 top and 100 recent top-level comment rows per video returned by yt-dlp, no replies. Deduplication by comment ID. Pinned promotional posts counted in retrieval but not treated as listening outcomes. No sentiment classifier or clinical outcome labeling.
limitations: Not random or representative; sorting, moderation, self-selection and duplicate text affect visibility.
Comments are not verified unique listeners; views are not unique patients.
Diagnoses, playback exposure, medications and before/after outcomes are unverified.
No causal inference or success-rate estimate is supported.
Promotional and formulaic praise text was observed; authenticity cannot be inferred.
Comments are multilingual and this was a qualitative reading, not an independently coded multilingual study.
product_hypotheses: Offer separate control of water/noise layers and tonal layers.
Use gradual onset, stable levels, dim mode and minimal interaction; avoid disruptive interruptions.
Ask about listening purpose and emotional effect, not just pain.
Capture nonresponse, discomfort and early stops alongside positive experiences.
Track context and concurrent care explicitly; do not train treatment labels from comment praise.

videos.label: Migraine / binaural recording
themes: Repeat listening and claimed relief; some describe distraction or sleep rather than complete pain removal.
Comment-section reassurance, darkness and minimal screen use matter.
Some listen alongside medication, rest or other measures, so attribution is unresolved.

contrasts.paraphrase: Reports the opening ping hurt head and ears at maximum volume.
Reports nausea while listening; causality unknown.

videos.label: Handpan recording
themes: Relaxation, focus during study/work, bedtime and emotional comfort recur.
Some report headache relief; others use it after an episode.
Comments value slow, warm timbre and a gentle background role.

contrasts.paraphrase: Expected calming but reports crying; emotional intensity is not necessarily harm.
Prefers this background style; other meditation music felt sad or overwhelming.
Questions what the title’s 777 Hz actually represents.

videos.label: Singing-bowl recording
themes: Sleep, concentration, calm and appreciation of uninterrupted listening recur.
Some combine the audio with slow breathing, rest or other ambient sounds.
Commenters describe varying and sustained tones; individual reactions differ.

contrasts.paraphrase: Finds volume changes annoying rather than soothing.
Reports nightmares after listening during sleep; causality unknown.
